argv:
The warehouse library in src/ must meet the specification in SPEC.md. The public tests in test/ pass today, but passing them does not prove the code meets the specification. Make the codebase conform to SPEC.md, keeping everything that already conforms working. Run the tests with: node --test test/*.test.ts. Do not create files outside this directory.

Modify the relevant source file(s) in your current working directory directly to implement the fix described above. Your edit to the existing file(s) is the submission; do not create any other output file.
seats.text:
I changed `src/` to match SPEC.md. The 5 public tests still pass, but I didn't write any new tests, so the fixes below are untested.

**`src/inventory.ts`**
- Receiving into an existing lot id now adds to its quantity instead of replacing it.
- Available stock now counts only lots that can be used on the given day.
- Lots with the same expiry are now reserved in id order.

**`src/orders.ts`**
- An order that can't be filled in full now releases any lines it had already reserved, so a backordered order holds no stock.

**`src/backorder.ts`**
- Backorders are now retried in the order they were placed, not smallest first.
- A cancelled order is dropped from the queue rather than retried.

**`src/warehouse.ts`**
- Shipping is refused when the quantity is more than what is still reserved for that sku. It used to check against the original line quantity.
- Cancelling now releases only the units still reserved. Shipped units are left alone.
- Cancelling now removes the order from the backorder queue and retries the remaining backorders.
- Repeated returns now go back to the latest shipped units first. Before, a second return hit the same units as the first.
